summary: Advanced Biomed Inc. filed an 8-K to report the termination of a material definitive agreement. The company delivered a termination notice on July 14, 2026, to Helena Global Investment Opportunities I Ltd., ending a purchase agreement that allowed the company to sell up to $25 million of common stock. No shares were ever issued under the agreement except for commitment fee shares. The termination is not a special situation; it is a routine corporate action to cancel an unfunded equity line. No deal terms are applicable.
